thread:
Iris: FYI saw a slow residency creep on kv-cluster-e during smoke canary at ~01:03 UTC, OOMs on two canaries by 01:07. Dash: https://metrics.internal/redwood/kv/cluster-e/allocs Heap: s3://redwood-infer/dumps/3243214321-kv-e-heap.tar.gz
Marco: Oncall. Pausing canary and cutting prefetch parallelism from 8->2. Need quick triage owners.
Iris: Quick pprof shows a cluster of retained refs from prefetch path and higher-than-usual freelist fragmentation. Top stacks reference kv_prefetch.go:194 and alloc_map.reserveFast.
Tess: I'll own triage and repro. Plan: 1) correlated slab-scan + vmstat at 30s intervals, 2) ms-resolution alloc sampling under repro, 3) attempt small race fuzz (cancel vs reserve). ETA: 36h for initial findings. Assigning to Tess.
Diego: Ops will add a temporary runtime cap `KV_MAX_RESIDENCY=105MB` on canaries and enable soft-eviction. Scheduling a rolling restart to apply. Creating ticket INF-1402.
ops-bot: Ticket INF-1402 created: "kv cluster-e temporary residency cap + slab-scan" https://jira.internal/INF-1402 Assigned to Diego, target: 2026-04-02.
ci-bot: Canary rollback executed -> rev 796 restored. Health checks passing. Monitoring window 30m. :white_check_mark:
Tess: Early hypothesis: cancellation fast-path in reserve may skip decrement in a corner-case; similar pattern to earlier regressions but stacks differ. Will grep recent PRs touching reserveFast and kv_prefetch.
Iris: Also check PR#901 and PR#912; both touched prefetch and freelist helpers. If Tess finds a narrow repro, let's prioritize a small targeted patch vs a broad refactor.
Diego: Ops notes: nightly slab-scan for 3 nights; will post digests here. Emergency commands will be added to INF-1402 runbook. Example: `kubectl set env deploy/kv-canary KV_MAX_RESIDENCY=105MB -n canary` and `./tools/ingress-circuit --pool kv-cluster-e --threshold 0.8`
Marco: I've muted pages for this shard while guard is in place and will own monitoring handoff until fix lands. I'll also scan last 60 days of slab-scan logs for matching stack signatures.
Tess: Uploading first profiler bundle to s3: s3://redwood-infer/profiles/3243214400-tess-profile.tar.gz. Running race fuzz now; will post minimal repro if found.
Iris: Action items (short): - Tess: repro + profiler + slab-scan correlation (36h) - Diego/Ops: apply cap + nightly slab-scan (today + 2 nights) - Marco: monitoring, alerts, historical grep (24h) - Iris: consolidate postmortem stub and cross-incident links (72h).
Tess: Found a small reproducer under a tight cancel/reserve loop; stack points to reserveFast -> freelist.release path missing on cancel. Preparing a unit test and proposed fix; will attach PR and perf regression test.
Diego: Nightly restart scheduled at 02:10 UTC. ops-bot will post progress.
ops-bot: Rolling restart started for kv-canary nodes. Progress: 3/5 complete.
Iris: Let's meet in 48h at 09:00 to review Tess's findings and decide whether to ship urgent patch to canary (small change) or gate a larger refactor. Reopen thread if anything spikes before then. :eyes:
